title: CLI Tool Package Profile v1
summary: A command-line tool or package with stable commands, configuration, structured output, tests, artifacts, and permissions.

integration_points.name: commands
integration_points.description: Command names, arguments, flags, defaults, examples, and exit codes.

integration_points.name: machine_output
integration_points.description: Structured output modes, files, reports, and generated artifacts.

integration_points.name: automation_safety
integration_points.description: Filesystem, network, secret, and destructive-operation permissions.

checks: Commands declare inputs, outputs, side effects, and exit codes.
Configuration sources and precedence are explicit.
Machine-readable output does not mix with progress text.
Destructive or external side effects require declared permissions.
Examples or fixtures cover primary command paths.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for CLIs and developer automation tools.
Prefer stable command and output surfaces over hidden conventions.
Report commands changed, structured outputs, and validation run.
